headline: 8th title: India win Women's Asia Cup after crushing Sri Lanka
summary: A record-breaking opening stand and a dominant spin attack led India to a 72-run victory in the final.
details: India secured their eighth Women's Asia Cup title and fourth in the T20 format after defeating Sri Lanka by 72 runs at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium on Sunday.
Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana set the stage with a record-breaking opening partnership of 129 runs, the highest for any wicket in Women's T20 Asia Cup history.
Shafali scored 68 off 39 balls, while Mandhana contributed 59 off 39 balls, helping India post a formidable total of 183-5.
Sri Lanka struggled in the chase, eventually being bundled out for 111. Chamari Athapaththu top-scored for the Lankans with 36 runs.
India's spin attack was dominant, with Shree Charani taking 4-20 and Deepti Sharma claiming 3-19.
With this win, India now lead Sri Lanka 6-1 in their Asia Cup final encounters.
caption:
A record-breaking opening stand and a dominant spin attack. India are the champions of Asia once again!

India secured their eighth Women's Asia Cup title and fourth in the T20 format after defeating Sri Lanka by 72 runs at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium on Sunday.

Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana set the stage with a record-breaking opening partnership of 129 runs, the highest for any wicket in Women's T20 Asia Cup history.

Shafali scored 68 off 39 balls, while Mandhana contributed 59 off 39 balls, helping India post a formidable total of 183-5.

Sri Lanka struggled in the chase, eventually being bundled out for 111. Chamari Athapaththu top-scored for the Lankans with 36 runs.

India's spin attack was dominant, with Shree Charani taking 4-20 and Deepti Sharma claiming 3-19.

With this win, India now lead Sri Lanka 6-1 in their Asia Cup final encounters.
